reason: The thumbnail shows a large glass/polycarbonate glazed greenhouse interior with hydroponic crop rows — this matches a premium glass or PC-sheet greenhouse segment, not the primary_segment (Naturally Ventilated Polyhouse with GI pipe frame and UV-stabilised PE film cover).
